# All geometry is estimated from camera calibration/depth and robot proprioception.
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares

def pstate(res):
    p=dict(zip(res.meta['proprio']['layout'],res.meta['proprio']['now']))
    q=np.array([p[f'robot0_joint{i}_pos'] for i in range(1,8)])
    x=np.array([p[f'eef_right_{a}'] for a in 'xyz'])
    C=np.array(res.meta['cameras']['robot0_eye_in_hand']['cam2world_gl'])
    return q,x,C

def command(q,tag,grip=-1,n=30,base=None,torso=0,mode=-1):
    A=np.zeros((n,13)); A[:,:7]=q; A[:,7]=grip;A[:,11]=torso;A[:,12]=mode
    if base is not None:A[:,8:11]=base
    res=r.submit('joint_position',A,video='none',include_depth=True,note=tag)
    res.save(ROOT/tag)
    q1,x,C=pstate(res)
    print(tag,'q',q1.round(5),'eef',x.round(5),'fingers',res.meta['proprio']['now'][11:13],'left',res.meta['time_left_s'],flush=True)
    return res

def fk(q):
    xyz=[[0,0,.333],[0,0,0],[0,-.316,0],[.0825,0,0],[-.0825,.384,0],[0,0,0],[.088,0,0]]
    rx=[0,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2]
    T=np.eye(4)
    for a,t,j in zip(rx,xyz,q):
        M=np.eye(4);M[:3,:3]=Rotation.from_euler('x',a).as_matrix();M[:3,3]=t
        Z=np.eye(4);Z[:3,:3]=Rotation.from_euler('z',j).as_matrix()
        T=T@M@Z
    return T

def calibrate():
    res=r.get_obs(video='none',include_depth=True);res.save(ROOT/'cal_start')
    q0,_,_=pstate(res)
    for j in range(7):
        q=q0.copy();q[j]+=.055
        command(q,f'cal_{j}',n=25)
        command(q0,f'cal_back_{j}',n=25)
    fit_model()

def fit_model():
    samples=[]
    for f in ROOT.glob('cal*/meta.json'):
        m=json.load(open(f));p=dict(zip(m['proprio']['layout'],m['proprio']['now']))
        q=np.array([p[f'robot0_joint{i}_pos'] for i in range(1,8)])
        x=np.array([p[f'eef_right_{a}'] for a in 'xyz']);C=np.array(m['cameras']['robot0_eye_in_hand']['cam2world_gl'])
        samples.append((fk(q),x,C))
    # world-from-arm base, grip offset in link7, and fixed wrist camera rotation.
    def residual(v):
        B=Rotation.from_rotvec(v[:3]).as_matrix();b=v[3:6];off=v[6:9];H=Rotation.from_rotvec(v[9:12]).as_matrix()
        return np.concatenate([np.r_[B@(F[:3,3]+F[:3,:3]@off)+b-x, .2*Rotation.from_matrix((B@F[:3,:3]@H).T@C[:3,:3]).as_rotvec()] for F,x,C in samples])
    v=np.zeros(12);v[2]=np.pi;v[3:6]=[2.6,-2,0.7];v[8]=.2
    fit=least_squares(residual,v,max_nfev=3000)
    np.save(ROOT/'kin_model.npy',fit.x)
    print('fit error',np.linalg.norm(fit.fun),fit.x)

def ik(x,C,q0):
    x=np.asarray(x);C=np.asarray(C)
